notes.title: Source Code & Documentation
notes.notes:
For the past week or so I've been working on a writeup for the source code to the game.  As of today that writeup is mostly complete and wanted to let everyone know of its availability.  The code and documentation are available on Github at the following link...

[url=https://github.com/ProfPorkins/Coronavirus-NanoForce] Source Code & Documentation [/url]

I wrote this game for [i]fun[/i], as a small hobby project.  My plan is to continue to improve the writeup and update the code according to some recommendations I've noted in the writeup.  All of this work will continue to be available online.

Even though I took a while to make the code available online, that was always my intention from the start.  While I wrote the game for my own enjoyment (writing the code is my fun), I also want to make it available for others to see how it was done, and possibly learn from my work.  Hope someone finds this useful or interesting in some way.
